notes: Static clang build (libtool archive .libs/libcrypt.a); bcrypt is in the default hash set (lib/hashes.conf: 'bcrypt $2b$ 16 STRONG,DEFAULT,ALT,FREEBSD,NETBSD,OPENBSD,OWL,SOLARIS,SUSE'). Probe uses crypt_r only (no global crypt state); 4 pthreads x 25 rounds on distinct crypt_data buffers each reproduce precomputed single-threaded results. Known-answer vector A is the tmp/rust-ref/vectors/rails_compat.json passwords.digests[0] digest for 'secret123456' ('$2a$12$I/2qP3ixlNN..JU2dXSN0umG7/Folk3aUaqgSHn/Rl0G82O9WYk66') asserted with an explicit '$2b$12$I/2qP3ixlNN..JU2dXSN0u' salt and cost 12; libxcrypt documents $2a$/$2b$ equality except for the historic >72-byte wraparound and this password is 12 bytes. Vector B is the standard published OpenBSD bcrypt regress vector (password 'U*U', salt '$2a$05$CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC.', published digest '$2a$05$CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC.E5YPO9kmyuRGyh0XouQYb4YMJKvyOeW'), asserted as the primary explicit $2b$ case with the $2a$ body as cross-check. Build note: upstream configure defaults to -Werror, which clang 23 trips in two optional non-bcrypt hash files (crypt-sm3-yescrypt.c, crypt-gost-yescrypt.c) with -Wincompatible-pointer-types-discards-qualifiers; the final recipe uses upstream's documented --disable-werror option. No upstream source was patched and no extra compiler flags were added.
